en.headline: Design at HKG runs Peak sensory installation until 24 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Design Centre's programme includes a free multi-sensory installation at the Peak and other citywide events through late November.
body: The Hong Kong Design Centre's Design at HKG 2026 programme continues this month with more than 40 events across the city, including a free multi-sensory installation at the Peak.

BREATHE WITH ME - SOFT RESET at the Peak Galleria offers a space with soft structures, light and sound for visitors to pause, and is open daily from 11am to 9pm until November 24, with some temporary closures for private use. Other elements include a travelling tram theatre, light art in Tsim Sha Tsui and design pop-ups.
The main activities run until November 24, with some exhibitions extending further. The programme is organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre with nearly 80 local and international partners.

zh.headline: 設計@HKG山頂多感官裝置展至11月24日
zh.dek: 香港設計中心主辦的活動包括山頂免費多感官裝置，以及全城其他設計項目，主要活動期至本月下旬。
body: 香港設計中心主辦的「設計@HKG」2026本月繼續舉行，全城有逾40項活動，包括山頂廣場的免費多感官裝置。
「BREATHE WITH ME－SOFT RESET」在山頂廣場以柔軟結構、光影與聲音構成休息空間，每日上午11時至晚上9時開放，至11月24日，部分時段因私人使用暫停。其他項目包括流動電車劇場、尖沙咀光影藝術及設計快閃店。
主要活動期至11月24日，部分展覽會延續更久。活動由香港設計中心聯同近80個本地及國際夥伴舉辦。
